{{Top|leg}}
A '''Tibbett plant''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] which was found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The Ewok known as [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] attempted to use [[Magic/Legends|magic]] to make a young potted Tibbett plant grow to adult size, and while he failed, the Ewok [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] still agreed to allow Teebo to become his apprentice.<ref name="2-18">{{Ewoks|Just My Luck}}</ref>
